newsitem.title: CANADA: Moore in alliance with C.I. Kasei.
newsitem.headline: Moore in alliance with C.I. Kasei.

text.p: Moore Corp Ltd said on Tuesday it signed a long-term technology transfer agreement with Japanese manufacturer C.I. Kasei under which C.I. Kasei would pay an annual fee to have access to a variety of Moore's proprietary labels technologies on a royalties basis.

Moore said the first initiative would involve linerless label production and marketing and later would include pressure sensitive labels and related bar code and automatic identification technologies.

"Our agreement with C.I. Kasei is a prime example of our mission to focus resources and attention on high-growth opportunities where we can accelerate the leverage of our core competencies and leading-edge technologies," said James Wyner, president of Moore's labels and label systems.
